Hi Marta — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications so we can move to an activation PO quickly: 

1) Insurance minimums we require for third-party suppliers (standard):
   - Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Professional Liability / E&O (if services include code or hosted services): $1,000,000
   - Cyber Liability (if handling customer data): $1,000,000
   - Umbrella/Excess: $2,000,000 (recommended)

2) Endorsement language: we generally ask for Additional Insured (where applicable) with wording that includes: "Redwood Inference, its officers, directors and employees" as Additional Insured on a primary & non-contributory basis for liability arising out of the services provided to Redwood. If your broker needs our template, I can send the standard endorsement sample.

3) Invoice routing / PO: please send invoices to ap-invoices@redwood.com and include the PO number on the invoice header when one exists. We can provision a conditional PO to allow first-month billing once we confirm COI + W9 + the subcontractor disclosure. If you need the PO before the first invoice, we can prioritize issuance once the packet is complete.

4) Subcontractors: please confirm which of the listed subcontractors will be performing work that touches Redwood systems or data. That will determine whether we need separate COIs for them.

5) Data processing: if you will process customer data on our behalf, send the DPA request checklist (we can link you to the template).

What I will do next:
- Share our endorsement template and COI checklist (attached).
- Ask Procurement to create your vendor record and queue the conditional PO.

Can you confirm by EOD whether Cyber coverage applies and whether the broker can issue the Additional Insured endorsement? If yes, we can turn the PO around within 48 hours.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
